本任务将 SUMMARY.md 中的目标落实到 `src/workspace/borrow.rs`，并与 `24-workspace §5, §6, §7, §8` 的 API、实现拆分和测试计划保持一致。

## 实施步骤

### Step 1: 实现核心代码

在 `src/workspace/borrow.rs` 中添加本任务要求的最小实现，保持职责边界与设计文档一致。

```rust
/// Immutable borrow guard — `!Send + !Sync` via `&'a Workspace`.
pub struct WorkspaceBorrow<'a> {
    ptr: core::ptr::NonNull<u8>,
    len: usize,
    workspace: &'a Workspace,
}

/// Mutable borrow guard — `!Send + !Sync` via `&'a Workspace`.
pub struct WorkspaceBorrowMut<'a> {
    ptr: core::ptr::NonNull<u8>,
    len: usize,
    workspace: &'a Workspace,
}

impl WorkspaceBorrow<'_> {
    pub fn len(&self) -> usize { self.len }
    pub fn as_maybe_uninit_slice(&self) -> &[core::mem::MaybeUninit<u8>] {
        unsafe { core::slice::from_raw_parts(self.ptr.as_ptr().cast(), self.len) }
    }
    pub(crate) fn as_ptr(&self) -> *const u8 { self.ptr.as_ptr() }
}

impl WorkspaceBorrowMut<'_> {
    pub fn len(&self) -> usize { self.len }
    pub fn as_maybe_uninit_slice(&mut self) -> &mut [core::mem::MaybeUninit<u8>] {
        unsafe { core::slice::from_raw_parts_mut(self.ptr.as_ptr().cast(), self.len) }
    }
    /// Produce an initialized slice over the prefix of `len` bytes.
    ///
    /// # Safety
    ///
    /// The caller must guarantee that the first `len` bytes have been
    /// fully initialized (all bit patterns are valid `u8`).
    pub unsafe fn assume_init_slice(&mut self, len: usize) -> &mut [u8] {
        debug_assert!(len <= self.len);
        core::slice::from_raw_parts_mut(self.ptr.as_ptr(), len)
    }
    pub(crate) fn as_ptr(&self) -> *const u8 { self.ptr.as_ptr() }
    pub(crate) fn as_mut_ptr(&self) -> *mut u8 { self.ptr.as_ptr() }
}

// --- borrow / borrow_mut on Workspace ---

impl Workspace {
    pub fn borrow(&self) -> crate::Result<WorkspaceBorrow<'_>> {
        self.borrow_state.compare_exchange(
            Self::BORROW_NONE, Self::BORROW_READ,
            core::sync::atomic::Ordering::Acquire,
            core::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed,
        ).map_err(|_| crate::error::XenonError::workspace_borrow_conflict())?;
        Ok(WorkspaceBorrow {
            ptr: self.ptr,
            len: self.capacity,
            workspace: self,
        })
    }

    pub fn borrow_mut(&self) -> crate::Result<WorkspaceBorrowMut<'_>> {
        self.borrow_state.compare_exchange(
            Self::BORROW_NONE, Self::BORROW_EXCLUSIVE,
            core::sync::atomic::Ordering::Acquire,
            core::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed,
        ).map_err(|_| crate::error::XenonError::workspace_borrow_conflict())?;
        Ok(WorkspaceBorrowMut {
            ptr: self.ptr,
            len: self.capacity,
            workspace: self,
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn is_borrowed(&self) -> bool {
        self.borrow_state.load(core::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed) != Self::BORROW_NONE
    }
}

// --- Drop impls ---

impl Drop for WorkspaceBorrow<'_> {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        self.workspace.borrow_state.store(Workspace::BORROW_NONE, core::sync::atomic::Ordering::Release);
    }
}

impl Drop for WorkspaceBorrowMut<'_> {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        self.workspace.borrow_state.store(Workspace::BORROW_NONE, core::sync::atomic::Ordering::Release);
    }
}
```

### Step 2: 单元测试

> **强制要求**:
> - 本步骤必须包含一个或者多个单元测试。
> - 测试函数名称和测试内容必须参考对应设计文档的 **「测试计划」** 一节。
> - 编译检查与Lint检查不等同于单元测试。
> - 如果测试没有通过需要修复直至测试通过。
> - **无测试 = 任务未完成。**

测试依据: `test_borrow_basic`、`test_borrow_mut_basic`、`test_borrow_double_fails`、`test_borrow_after_drop`、`test_assume_init_requires_initialized_prefix` 验证借用状态机和 MaybeUninit 语义。

```rust
#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use crate::workspace::Workspace;

    #[test]
    fn test_borrow_basic() {
        let ws = Workspace::new(32, 64).unwrap();
        let guard = ws.borrow().unwrap();
        let slice = guard.as_maybe_uninit_slice();
        assert_eq!(slice.len(), 32);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_borrow_mut_basic() {
        let ws = Workspace::new(32, 64).unwrap();
        let mut guard = ws.borrow_mut().unwrap();
        {
            let raw = guard.as_maybe_uninit_slice();
            assert_eq!(raw.len(), 32);
        }
        let init = unsafe { guard.assume_init_slice(16) };
        assert_eq!(init.len(), 16);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_borrow_double_fails() {
        let workspace = Workspace::new(64, 64).unwrap();
        let _guard = workspace.borrow().unwrap();
        assert!(workspace.borrow().is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_borrow_after_drop() {
        let workspace = Workspace::new(64, 64).unwrap();
        drop(workspace.borrow().unwrap());
        assert!(workspace.borrow().is_ok());
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_assume_init_requires_initialized_prefix() {
        let ws = Workspace::new(1024, 64).unwrap();
        let mut guard = ws.borrow_mut().unwrap();
        // Initialize 16 bytes manually
        for (i, slot) in guard.as_maybe_uninit_slice().iter_mut().take(16).enumerate() {
            slot.write(i as u8);
        }
        let init = unsafe { guard.assume_init_slice(16) };
        assert_eq!(&init[..3], &[0, 1, 2]);
    }
}
```

## 关键设计决策

| 决策 | 依据 |
|------|------|
| Workspace 暴露 MaybeUninit 视图 | `24-workspace.md §1.2` 要求未初始化感知 |
| 借用状态由 RAII guard 归还 | `24-workspace.md §5.6` 定义 Drop 释放状态 |
| ensure_capacity 只增长不缩容 | `24-workspace.md §1.2` 避免内存抖动 |

## 验证方式

1. 编译检查: `cargo check`
2. Lint 检查: `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features`
3. 测试验证: `cargo test workspace --all-features`
4. 手动验证: 运行一个创建、借用、释放、扩容的最小示例。

## 注意事项

- 借用期间不得重新分配或扩容。
- typed view 只能在 Element 闭集内使用，并由调用方证明初始化。
- Workspace 和所有 guard 保持 `!Send + !Sync`。
